Easy to use. I was looking for an app that would be easy for my elderly mother (93 y/o) to use. It needs to be ad free no matter how much it costs. I was specifically looking for water sounds. 

I read many reviews (always start with sorting “most recent” and look at one star reviews) and tried three apps. After several nights with each, I chose Sleep Owl and paid a one-time price of $20 for an extensive set of all available sounds. There were cheaper packages, but I pay more than this for one meal at a Thai restaurant and this bought me more than 200 sounds. 

Sleep Owl is very stable and has a very intuitive UI. It uses photos to show what the sound will be, so mom doesn’t need to find her glasses. She can mark sounds as favorites which will show up in a sort option. 

Also we went through and selected different combinations of three sounds to save together, such as two different rain patterns with ocean waves lapping gently. There are several affirmations available and this would be a good place to use them. Each sound can have the volume adjusted independently. But I wasn’t a fan of their chosen affirmations, they seemed blunt and the rhythm of speaking was odd.

Sleep Owl sorts sounds into categories, such as water, win/fired, animals, urban (cars, trains, coffee house), brain waves, gentle music, several others including a heartbeat to use for infants. Surprisingly, the selection of white noise, pink noise, brown noise, etc is limited to just two options. But there are 7 wind chimes and temple bells! Lots of fans available, 2 fish tanks, radio static hiss, scuba diver, airplanes droning. 

Mom loves this app and wants to tell everyone about it! I am now using Sleep Owl myself instead of MyNoise which I bought because it can be calibrated to counteract tinnitus (look on their website). MyNoise is now a monthly subscription and also it works best with headphones or earbuds which I don’t like to sleep with.
